subject: Q3 partner newsletter — promo-pass issuance & escrow checklist
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Q3 partner newsletter — promo-pass issuance & escrow checklist

Team —

We need to finalize the promo-pass batch for OpenPanels' partner newsletter going out next Tuesday (2026-08-11). Key asks:

- Approve the batch file (attached: promo_batch_08-04.csv). It contains 3,000 single-use codes, 30-day trials, no auto-renew.
- Confirm escrow instructions and signing party (attached: fulfillment-checklist.odt).
- Confirm the redemption window (we currently propose Aug 11 — Sep 10) and a small grace period.

Operational constraints: Dedicated customer seats are provisioned for the campaign; if we push the launch later than Aug 11 we must re-run allocation and notify capacity planning. Deal DL-4782 is green-lit for promo allowance; finance will reconcile after redemption completes.

Pls reply with sign-off or edits by EOD (PDT) today — Marissa, Ben: can you review the checklist and escrow steps? Monica, loop in CS if we need a sample of proof-of-redemption.

Thanks,
Markus
Head of Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: promo_batch_08-04.csv (CSV), fulfillment-checklist.odt (ODT)

Subject: Re: Q3 partner newsletter — promo-pass issuance & escrow checklist

Thanks Markus — quick read: overall looks fine. Two questions:

1) Do we need segment-level limits? The CSV currently includes a "global" column but no per-segment cap. OpenPanels asked for VIP-only batch (500 codes) + general (2,500).
2) Can we add an expiration label in the email to avoid confusion (e.g., "Valid until Sep 10, 2026 PST").

If Ben confirms escrow flow, I'm happy to sign off.

-Marissa
Sr. Partnerships Manager

Markus / Marissa —

I reviewed the CSV quickly. Operational notes:

- We'll split the file into two batches during ingestion (VIP: first 500 rows flagged "VIP", remainder general). I'll annotate the CSV and resend if you want.
- Escrow: use our standard two-key release process. See attached escrow-instructions.pdf — customer must accept T&Cs before codes are active; we'll hold codes in escrow until OpenPanels confirms delivery.
- Redemption sample: I'll generate a small proof-of-redemption image after we run an internal dry-run. That will look like the attached partner-redemption-sample.png (stub).

I approve the timeline Aug 11 — Sep 10 with a 48-hour grace window. If OpenPanels needs a later start, we can hold the batch in escrow but will need 24 hours notice to re-open.

Ben
Partner Ops Lead

Attachments: escrow-instructions.pdf (PDF), partner-redemption-sample.png (PNG)

Hi Markus —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. OpenPanels is OK with the VIP / general split. A couple of asks from our side:

- Can you confirm that VIP codes are single-use and will be invalidated after first redemption?
- Could you provide a small sample of the redemption confirmation graphic we can include in our newsletter? (we typically show a small badge to reassure users)
- Slight request: could we push the activation to Aug 12 (one day later) to align with our send schedule?

If you can confirm by EOD PT we can lock the newsletter.

Thanks,
Susan Liu
